paper.review_basis: Original publisher PDF text, printed page 671; no visual-table claim.

measurements: Preserved-structure retention/density specimens: 50-mm diameter and 30-mm high rings from the 0-0.20-m layer.
Retention regimes include 0,1,6,10,33,100,1500 kPa; the paper evaluates gravimetric water at 33 and 1500 kPa.
Disturbed texture aliquots: Day (1965) pipette method, with 1 mol/L NaOH dispersion.
Carbon: Walkley-Black; organic matter computed as carbon times 1.724.

sampling.location: Capao do Leao, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
sampling.warning: Spatial grid points are not demonstrated independent profile-level population replicates.

hybras_linkage.shared_reference: The second reference of the Nebel group is byte-identical to the first reference of the Parfitt-only group.
hybras_linkage.warning: Hashing reference pairs creates different source IDs despite shared primary lineage. Those IDs do not establish independent studies.

decisions: Do not silently label the two citation groups as independent validation units.
Do not grant sand sieve/organic-matter-removal equivalence solely from the generic pipette label.
Preserve HYBRAS volumetric target units, but verify the original gravimetric-to-volume lineage before using source-specific conversions.
The 50x30-mm ring does not match the Gunarathna density predictor protocol of 54x60 mm.
